```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(CLAMPData)
library(ExperimentHub)
```

# Introduction

This vignette demonstrates how to access data resources provided by **CLAMPData** through the [ExperimentHub](https://bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/html/ExperimentHub.html) interface. 

# Accessing data resources

```{r list, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
if (exists("GSE164416_DP_htseq_counts_txt_gz", where = "package:CLAMPData")) {
  
  # 1. Raw Counts Data (gzipped text file)
  p_counts <- try(GSE164416_DP_htseq_counts_txt_gz(), silent = TRUE)
  
  # 2. H5 Pathway Priors Data (HDF5 file)
  p_h5     <- try(human_gene_v2_5_alz_h5(), silent = TRUE)
  
  # 3. Sample Metadata (CSV file)
  p_meta   <- try(islets_metadata_csv(), silent = TRUE)

  if (!inherits(p_counts, "try-error")) {
    
    cat("--- Successfully retrieved file paths ---\n")
    cat("Counts path:", p_counts, "\n")
    cat("H5 path:", p_h5, "\n")
    cat("Metadata path:", p_meta, "\n")
    
  } else {
    cat("Accessors not yet functional — package likely built before data registration.\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("Accessor functions not yet available in this build.\n")
}
```

# Reading example data

```{r accessors, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
if (exists("p_counts") && !inherits(p_counts, "try-error")) {
  
  ## 1. Reading the counts file (gzipped)
  cat("\n--- Counts File Preview (GSE164416) ---\n")
  readLines(gzfile(p_counts), n = 5)

  ## 2. Inspecting the HDF5 file structure
  if (requireNamespace("rhdf5", quietly = TRUE)) {
    cat("\n--- HDF5 File Structure (human_gene_v2_5_alz_h5) ---\n")
    rhdf5::h5ls(p_h5)
  } else {
    message("\nrhdf5 package is required to inspect the H5 file.")
  }

  ## 3. Reading the metadata CSV
  cat("\n--- Metadata Preview (islets_metadata) ---\n")
  head(read.csv(p_meta, stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  
} else {
  cat("Example file reading skipped (resources not yet available or functional).\n")
}
```
